decision.fixture_fix: user 2026-10-24 approved: fix the frozen scene-a perspective camera (missing focal length / principal point produced all-zero cam_intrinsic and the 180-degree cam_fovy sentinel, so MJWarp emitted zero-length rays and rendered that camera as pure background), then re-run parity and re-pin hashes; parity conclusion unchanged

fix.reason: cam-persp had sensorsize without focal/principal; MuJoCo 3.12 and 3.15 identically produced cam_intrinsic=(0,0,0,0) and cam_fovy=180.00000500895632, and MJWarp render_util.compute_ray divides by fx=0 -> zero ray directions -> background-only image. S0a only compared model arrays and did not render, so both versions agreed on the broken values and parity passed. The defect only surfaced in S0b.
fix.change: scene.xml cam-persp: added focalpixel="160 160" (+ explanatory comment); focalpixel 160 on the 320px sensor gives cam_intrinsic=(0.018,0.016,0,0) and cam_fovy=73.73979461915735 in both MuJoCo versions; cam-track (fovy branch) unaffected

(4,233 B); scene.xml hashes are now computed over LF-normalized bytes (CRLF->LF) in both the S0a parity script and the S0b capture script, so checkout line-ending configuration cannot change the recorded hash
